games.summary: Right-side half-ice game. Blue won 3–2: goals at 0:50, 20:07 and 43:10, with TW Red scoring at 19:48 and 22:18. All goals were confirmed by a parent. Shots were counted frame by frame in close-ups of each net, and a shot only counts if the puck is seen going at the net, so treat the shot totals as close rather than official.
Left-side half-ice game from the same session. Warm-up runs for about the first 5 minutes.
